```yamlfile
name: Github PR
on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: read-all
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  cmake-build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        cxx_standard: [11]
        build: [static]
        googletest: [build]
        generator: ["Default Generator"]
    env:
      YAML_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS: 'OFF'
      YAML_USE_SYSTEM_GTEST: 'OFF'
      CMAKE_GENERATOR: ''
      CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX: "${{ github.workspace }}/install-prefix"
      CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE: Debug
      CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG: '-g -D_GLIBCXX_DEBUG -D_GLIBCXX_DEBUG_PEDANTIC'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: awalsh128/cache-apt-pkgs-action@latest
        with:
          packages: googletest libgmock-dev libgtest-dev
          version: 1.0

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2

      - name: Configure
        run: |
          cmake \
            \
            -S "${{ github.workspace }}" \
            -B build \
            -D CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=11 \
            -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="${{ env.CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX }}" \
            -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
            -D CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG="-g -D_GLIBCXX_DEBUG -D_GLIBCXX_DEBUG_PEDANTIC" \
            -D YAML_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
            -D YAML_USE_SYSTEM_GTEST=OFF \
            -D YAML_CPP_BUILD_TESTS=ON

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cmake \
            --build build \
            --config Debug \
            --verbose \
            --parallel

      - name: Run Tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          ctest \
            --test-dir build \
            --build-config Debug \
            --output-on-failure \
            --verbose

      - name: Install
        run: cmake --install build --config Debug

      - name: Configure CMake package test
        run: |
          cmake \
            \
            -S "${{ github.workspace }}/test/cmake" \
            -B consumer-build \
            -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
            -D CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${{ env.CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX }}"

      - name: Build CMake package test
        run: |
          cmake \
            --build consumer-build \
            --config Debug \
            --verbose
```
